Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 8, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Junior High Pastor Travis Sybert, North Coast Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.

Resolution No. 2008- , City of Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1;

2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a cost-sharing agreement with the Buena Sanitation District;
3.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , approving an amendment to the Operating Budget for the 2007-2009 fiscal years; and
4.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , approving a cost-sharing agreement with the City of Vista.
